draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.00, the 134th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 11th of 20 at S. He went 152nd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 53 tackles in 2021, 14th of 19 Ss in his class with stats.
